desc: The join rule on one computer: co-op's setting off, controller 3 there but unseated; its Start in the field seats it (the next free seat: a test's scripted controller stays in its port, so 3P) and the join note comes up at 3P's place in the middle ("3P Joined! {START} for your menu"); the press that seats it doesn't open the card, and player 1's Start menu never opens. Shots: the join note, it gone
